story.title: The boy with bad luck
paragraphs_en: There was once a boy called Jeremy . He always had bad luck each day . Every time he goes to school , bird poop will fall on his head . At school , he would have the lunch that was thrown in the garbage can . He always say to himself ‘ Is there anything that can be a good luck to me ! ‘

Each day when he goes to school , he would wear a frown face to school . He didn’t laugh or smile at school . He just sat on his chair and waited for the school bells to ring and eat . His mom always encourage him to be happy and make some new friends , but he can’t .

When he arrived at school each day , he would sit on a wall . People always looked at him asking if he’s ok ? He told them ‘ My father died last night ! I am so sad . Why do I always have the worst luck ? ‘ Jeremy asked . A girl said ‘ Maybe because your father might have a disease and died . But I am sorry for you . ‘ He walked away , and went in the classroom .

When he went in to the classroom , each student need to talk to the teacher how they feel today . But Jeremy always says It am feeling sad , so don’t talk to me ok ? ‘ The teacher was silent ‘ Oh ok ... ‘ He walked away and sat behind a student tall , to cover up his face . He also doesn’t like anyone noticing him .

At lunch time , he would go back to his home to eta , but when he got home the food his mom cooked for him was rotten , because his mom can’t see anything , so she doesn’t know that that’s rotten . He said desperately ‘ Uhhh... I will never have anything good luck to me . ‘ He went back to school again .

‘Time for singing the school song ! ‘ A teacher announced . All the students went to the hall and stranded they all sang perfectly except Jeremy, his singing voice was terrible , everyone looked at him . They stared at him for a long time . Some mean boys laughed at him . This wasn’t good . It’s but the time they go home .

After school , everyone has left . Jeremy and his friend walked across the road . There were mean boys following them secretly , then they put a water bottle under Jeremy’s pants and said he peed on the floor . Everyone laughed . Jeremy was embarrassed.

When he got back home , he stood out of his balcony crying with tears spreading out his eyes . His dog came out hiding behind the door . He cried and cried he praised ‘Dear Lord , could you please help me , can you please give just for one day , just give ,e good luck. ‘He sobbed . He ran back in and hid under his wooden torn bed .

It was night time , the sky was dark and shivering cold . Jeremy sat beside a wooden bench and looked in the sky , ‘ Hmmm .. I wish I could be some of the lucky kids one day . ‘He hesitated to himself. He saw a wishing star passed by he makes a wish and went back into his room and dreamt of being a lucky kid .

This story tells us that we should always treasure the time you had in your life . You should always thank god for giving you a wonderful world . Some kids aren’t as lucky as us . They might have no food , no clothes , no games or books , so we should treasure what we have and don’t complain.
No matter who you are just look at the bright side and there is the future ahead of you . This is the end of my story . Thanks . Bye !
